title: Blade Surface Erosion
description: Leading edge erosion detected on Blade A. Surface degradation consistent with particle impact damage. Recommend protective coating inspection.

title: Lightning Strike Damage
description: Possible lightning strike damage identified near blade tip. Visible discoloration and surface scarring. Structural integrity assessment recommended.

title: Coating Delamination
description: Gelcoat delamination observed on Blade B trailing edge. Area approximately 0.5m². Monitor for expansion in subsequent inspections.

title: Nacelle Oil Leak
description: Minor oil residue detected on nacelle exterior near gearbox housing. Pattern suggests slow seepage from gearbox seal. Schedule maintenance inspection.

title: Tower Corrosion
description: Surface corrosion identified on tower flange joint at 40m elevation. Rust spots visible around bolt heads. Protective coating touch-up required.

title: Blade Crack Detection
description: Potential hairline crack identified on Blade C root section. High priority for ultrasonic testing verification. Mark for immediate follow-up.

title: Bird Debris Accumulation
description: Organic debris buildup on blade surfaces reducing aerodynamic efficiency. Bird strike residue and nesting material detected. Cleaning scheduled.

title: Electrical Cable Wear
description: Cable insulation wear detected on external routing along tower. UV degradation visible on protective sheathing. Replacement recommended within 6 months.

title: Foundation Settlement
description: Minor ground settlement indicators around turbine foundation. No immediate structural concern but recommend monitoring during next quarterly inspection.

title: Pitch System Anomaly
description: Blade pitch alignment deviation detected on Blade A. 2.3° variance from nominal. Pitch bearing inspection and calibration may be required.
